env.jishuAgentImportance: Jishu Agent is the core engine of this application. Installing it unlocks full file system operations, native command execution, and powerful MCP services. Highly recommended.
env.jishuAgentRestartRequired: Jishu Agent has been updated. Restart Jishu Hub to stop the old runtime process and use the latest version for new sessions.
env.installFailedUnknown: Unknown error, check the console log
env.uacCancelled: Administrator authorization was cancelled; nothing was installed. Retry and choose Yes in the authorization dialog.
env.pathAddedHint: Installed successfully. The npm global bin directory was missing from PATH and has been added to your user PATH: {{dir}}. Open a new terminal window for the command to be recognized (already-open windows will not inherit it).
env.updateVersionMismatch: The detected version after updating is still {{current}}; target version: {{target}}
env.mcpDesc: Provides Jishu Agent with MCP service capabilities (web search, web reading, etc.)
env.bridgeDesc: Runs claude_code over ACP via this bridge, enabling mid-turn structured questions; falls back to CLI mode when absent
env.cliDesc: To conveniently launch Jishu Hub from external terminals, installing the jishu command is strongly recommended (requires authorization).
env.elevationDesc: Installing "{{name}}" writes to system directories (the Chocolatey install location), so it must run as administrator. After you choose "Continue", a system authorization (UAC) window will appear — click "Yes" there to grant it. Choosing "Cancel" aborts the install.

config.title: Configuration
config.nativeFormatHint: Edit the agent's config file in its native format
config.modelsHint: Edits ~/.jishu-agent/models.json directly — the same file the agent reads on startup. The active (provider, model) is stored in ~/.jishu-hub/settings.json.
config.presetStepModels: Recommended models (tap to toggle; all values editable later)
config.presetApiHint: Auto-filled for the chosen provider; usually no change needed
config.testConnectionHint: Sends a minimal test message and shows the reply
config.testConnectionHeaderHint: Test API connectivity with the current draft (unsaved edits included)
config.activeModelCustomHint: No match — type a model ID and press Enter

full.title: Full capabilities
full.desc: Read/write files and run commands (sensitive ops confirmed per permission mode)

readonly.title: Read-only mode
readonly.desc: Read and search only — no file edits, no commands; safest

toolMode.restartHint: Live sessions restart automatically to apply the change (history preserved).

config.modelSuggestPlaceholder: Pick a recommended model to auto-fill
config.modelSuggestHint: Auto-fills context window and other params; you can still type manually
config.modelComboboxPlaceholder: Pick a recommended model, or type any model ID
config.modelComboboxOptional: Leave empty for default; any model ID accepted
config.testNoKeyHint: No API key detected. If you sign in with a subscription, skip the test and start chatting.
config.apiKeyHint: Stored in plain text in models.json
config.noProviders: No providers yet. Click 'Add provider' to register one (e.g. zhipu, openai, anthropic).
config.jishuSelfHint: jishu agent configuration = ~/.jishu-agent/models.json (the same file the agent reads). Core fields are visual; advanced fields use JSON.
config.authHeaderHint: When enabled, the API key is sent in the Authorization request header instead of X-Api-Key.
config.noModelsHint: Type a model id and press Enter to add. Each model can have its own context window, max tokens, baseUrl, etc.
config.compatHint: The compat field's shape depends on the API protocol. Common keys: supportsDeveloperRole, openRouterRouting, vercelGatewayRouting.
config.modelOverridesHint: Override fields per model id, e.g. { "glm-5.1": { "maxTokens": 16384 } }.
config.skipDangerousDesc: When enabled, Claude Code executes sensitive operations (file write/delete, command execution) without confirmation prompts. Risk of unintended changes — recommended only in trusted environments
config.templateDesc: Templates are predefined configurations that can be quickly applied to your current settings.
config.templateAgentScope: Showing templates for agent: {{agent}}. Templates created for other agents are hidden.
config.noUserTemplatesDesc: Save your current configuration as a template to reuse
config.templateDescPlaceholder: Briefly describe the purpose of this template
config.editHint: You can edit the JSON directly
config.fillRequiredDesc: Please fill in the following fields to use this template
config.modelIdPlaceholder: e.g., claude-sonnet-4-6 or custom model ID
config.backupDesc: Backups are created automatically before each config save. Click restore to revert to a previous configuration.
config.noBackupsDesc: Backups are created automatically when you save configuration changes

default.title: Ask me every time
default.desc: Confirms before file edits and commands; the safest option

bypass.title: Run fully automatic
bypass.desc: Edits files and runs commands without asking; enable only in trusted projects

plan.title: Discuss first, then act
plan.desc: Read-only analysis and proposals; nothing is changed until you approve

config.mcpJsonHint: Edit MCP server definitions as JSON.
config.modelManagerDesc: Configure LLM model providers (OpenAI and Anthropic compatible). Used by the agent and task orchestration.
config.noModelsDesc: Click 'Add Model' above to configure your first model
config.apiKeyStorageHint: Key is saved locally in config file. You can also override via environment variable. Click the key row on any model to edit.
config.modelIdNotEditable: Model ID cannot be changed after creation
config.noActiveModel: No active model — activate a model above
config.activeModelSyncHint: Auto-synced from the model list above. Use the power icon on a preset to switch.
config.connectDirectHint: Direct connection: sign in with a Claude subscription, or reach the official API directly — no channel needed. Switch to "Use Proxy" for third-party channels.
config.codexDirectHint: Currently direct: authenticate with your OpenAI account (codex login) to use official models; no provider needed. Pick a third-party channel on the left (Zhipu / DashScope / Kimi / DeepSeek) to switch to a proxy.
config.codexCustomChannelHint: Create a custom provider with an id, endpoint and key; the endpoint must support the OpenAI Responses API. It appears in the channel list after creation.
config.codexCustomModelHint: Custom models are remembered locally per channel (never written into codex config files) for newly released models; press the button on the right to set one as current.
config.channelPickHint: Picking a channel auto-fills its base URL and recommended model; the green dot marks the channel in effect.
config.channelSaveHint: Switching channels or saving a key only updates the draft; press "Save" in the header to write the config file.
config.modelEnvEmpty: No model-related environment variables configured yet (ANTHROPIC_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, etc.).
config.modelEnvHint: These are the environment variables actually in effect for the model path (secrets masked); edit them under Environment Variables in advanced settings.
config.proxyChatHint: This endpoint is OpenAI Chat Completions compatible (wire_api = chat).
config.officialAuthHintCodex: Direct connection requires an OpenAI account: press "Authenticate" to run codex login in a terminal; the browser opens automatically to finish authorization.
config.officialAuthHintClaude: Direct connection requires an Anthropic subscription: press "Authenticate" to open a terminal running claude, then type /login inside it to finish browser authorization.
config.officialAuthRefreshHint: Re-enter this page after finishing to refresh the status.
config.channelCustomHint: Custom channel: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN under Advanced → Environment Variables.
config.channelSelectHint: Select a channel on the left, or press "Add" to create one
config.applyTemplateSuccess: Template applied and written to the config file
config.templateModelStoreHint: The chosen provider is merged into the model store (existing providers kept); behavior settings go to the global config.
config.templateProvidersHint: The provider is merged into your existing provider list (others kept); main/small models follow the template.
config.proxyResponsesHint: The endpoint must support the OpenAI Responses API (Chat Completions-compatible endpoints will not work).
config.thinkingLevelsHint: Tick the levels this model actually supports: the chat selector only offers ticked levels, and an unsupported persisted level snaps to the nearest one. Presets come pre-filled from official docs.
config.reasoningEffortHint: Controls reasoning depth (codex model_reasoning_effort). Takes effect for new sessions; xhigh only on some newer models.
config.thinkingBudgetHint: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: larger = deeper thinking; 0 = disable thinking; remove the variable to follow defaults. New sessions only.
config.customProvidersEmptyHint: Enter a provider id (e.g. zhipu) on the left and add it; after configuring the URL and key, its models appear in the model card above
config.customProvidersHint: Model ids use the provider/model form; save (header) writes the provider section of opencode.json.
config.jishuBehaviorHintV3: Global defaults for new sessions (thinking level, context compaction, initial tools, request retry); project settings can override thinking level and compaction. In-session controls (tool mode full/readonly, temporary thinking level) live next to the chat input; model choice is under Models.
config.defaultThinkingLevelHelp: Writes the jishu agent's global default thinking level (defaultThinkingLevel); applies to newly started sessions. In-session switching is unaffected.
config.compactionHelp: Automatic summarization when context nears the window (compaction). This is the global default; project settings take precedence.
config.compactionDefaultHint: When unset it is enabled by default: reserve 16384 tokens, keep recent 20000 tokens. Empty fields fall back to defaults.
config.defaultToolsHelp: Built-in tools active at session start (defaultTools). This is the agent's tool whitelist; the in-session tool mode (full/readonly) narrows it further.
config.toolPresetReadonlyHint: Read-only: new sessions activate only Read/Grep/Find/List; the tool set is fixed.
config.toolPresetAllHint: All tools: new sessions activate every built-in tool (including Bash and file writes); the tool set is fixed.
config.defaultToolsUnsetHint: Not configured: new sessions activate Read/Bash/Edit/Write by default.
config.defaultToolsCustomHint: Custom initial tool set: only checked tools activate in new sessions; unchecking all means no built-in tools.
config.retryHelp: Automatic retry policy after model request failures (retry).
config.retryDefaultHint: When unset it is enabled by default: up to 3 retries with a 2000ms base delay (exponential backoff). Empty fields fall back to defaults.
